events.description: Multiple players from both teams (WPG in white/blue, MIN in green) engage in a multi-person scrum along the boards, with grabbing, shoving, and helmet-to-helmet contact; referees intervene to separate them.

verification.reason: Frames f3–f23 show sustained physical combat: players are locked together, punching/shoving (e.g., f9–f12), helmets are displaced, sticks are dropped or used defensively, and multiple referees actively pull players apart—meeting the definition of Fighting (mutual physical combat). The event is continuous from f3 onward, so candidates 3, 5, and 6 describe overlapping phases of the same incident and are merged.

rejected.reason: No mutual physical combat (e.g., punching, grappling, dropping gloves) is visible; the interaction from f4 onward shows a legal body check into the boards followed by a fall—ordinary competitive hockey play, not Fighting.
The player who falls (#9) is not helpless at the time of contact; the collision occurs during active puck pursuit and board engagement, with no post-fall aggression—no Abuse evident.
Same as candidate 0: sustained board contact and fall are consistent with legal checking, not mutual physical combat as defined; thus not Fighting.
